keccak_to_sha3.description: content address / links / delivery digest computed with SHA3-256 instead of Keccak-256

codepoint_key_order.description: JCS keys sorted by Unicode code point instead of UTF-16 code units

no_number_domain.description: non-integer number tokens and integers beyond 2^53-1 are serialized instead of rejected

no_seq_completeness.description: chain_set skips the every-seq-exactly-once check (missing / duplicate)

no_link_recompute.description: chain_set does not recompute a presented `link`

no_accumulator.description: chain_commitment does not compare head.acc with the fold

no_independence.description: independence_claim does not require a non-party attestor

no_identity_normalization.description: identities compared byte-exact (no strip / lowercase / trailing-punctuation fold)

no_record_commits_presence.description: a declared `record_commits` field is ignored instead of rejected

declared_commits.description: commitments are read from a declared `record_commits` list when present (the n22 override bug)

no_coverage_bound.description: boundary_binding does not compare covered_through with attestedPrefixLength

phase_any.description: phase_claim accepts any phase token (no vocabulary, no equality)

no_unknown_claim_reject.description: unknown independence claim tokens are ignored instead of rejected

no_digest_compare.description: digest_recompute: expected_digest is parsed but never compared

numeric_hoist_keys.description: JCS: integer-like keys sorted numerically first (JS engine hoisting)

insertion_order_keys.description: JCS: object keys emitted in insertion order (no sort)

strict_below_2_53.description: number domain: |n| <= 2^53-2 (rejects the boundary value 2^53-1 itself)

reject_payload_text.description: canonical_bytes: the raw-text (payload_text) pathway rejects unconditionally

json_parse_collapses_integral_floats.description: loader: integer-valued float tokens (2.0, 3.0) collapse to int (JSON.parse engine)

no_link_compare.description: chain_link: expected_link parsed but never compared

no_anchor_compare.description: anchor_relation: sha256(subject) never compared with anchored_digest

no_prev_continuity.description: chain_set: prev_digest not compared with the previous record's artifact digest

no_head_digest_binding.description: chain_set: head.digest not compared with the final record's artifact digest

no_genesis_null_prev.description: chain_set: genesis record may carry a non-null prev_digest

witness_counts_as_presence.description: chain_set: a witnessed inclusion (leaf index) counts as a present record

acc_last_link_only.description: chain_commitment: head.acc compared with keccak(acc_0 || last link) only

phase_vocab_only.description: phase_claim: vocabulary checked, equality record/presented NOT checked

phase_equality_only.description: phase_claim: equality checked, vocabulary NOT checked

phase_later_only.description: phase_claim: reject only when presented as a LATER phase than the record's (spec's literal wording)

reject_all_party_only.description: independence: unconditional rejector of party-only attested records, whatever is claimed

attestations_default_empty.description: independence: a missing `attestations` field is read as an empty list

attestation_string_as_by.description: independence: a bare-string attestation is read as {by: string}

settlement_any_string.description: derivation: settlement committed when success is true and transaction is ANY string (empty ok)

trust_declared_delivery_digest.description: derivation: delivery committed when digest present, bytes NOT recomputed

derive_nothing.description: derivation: commitments always empty when the fields are present

addr_only_identity.description: identity: only 0x-addresses parse (scheme-qualified identifiers fail closed)

no_trailing_punct_fold.description: identity: scheme identifiers compared without trailing / . # fold

case_fold_scheme_ids.description: identity: scheme identifier paths compared case-insensitively

no_offer_compare.description: offer_binding: digest present but not compared

no_offer_presence.description: offer_binding: a receipt without offerDigest is accepted

no_decision_presence.description: decision_evidence_binding: a record without decisionEvidenceDigest is accepted

no_decision_compare.description: decision_evidence_binding: digest present but not compared

redigest_under_toSuite.description: boundary: prefixDigest recomputed under the SUCCESSOR suite at a transition

no_boundary_vocab.description: boundary: any event / ruleVersion / fromSuite accepted

no_position_apl_optional.description: boundary: position not required AND attestedPrefixLength optional
